label: configurator • bind an installed workflow to a weekday schedule (no agent)
query: Run my Daily Digest workflow every weekday at 8am.
notes: Workflow-first routing. `Daily Digest` is installed with one required string input `day`. A weekday-at-8 schedule is only expressible as cron `0 8 * * 1-5`. The automation must run the workflow (not an agent), bind `day` (for example to {{schedule.scheduled_for}}), and the case must not create an agent. State is checked against the live automation store, not just the arguments.
